maddeler.e:
تعرقبت (form IIq)
# تَعَرْقَبْتُ (taʕarqabtu) /ta.ʕar.qab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تَعَرْقَبْتَ (taʕarqabta) /ta.ʕar.qab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تَعَرْقَبْتِ (taʕarqabti) /ta.ʕar.qab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تَعَرْقَبَتْ (taʕarqabat) /ta.ʕar.qa.bat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
